SELECT f.id, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS observedAt, f.bqpg, f.fzjc FROM patient_follow_up_history f JOIN patient_basic_info p ON p.id = f.patient_basic_info_id WHERE AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY p.id, f.id
